ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit pre-encryption 'scorched earth' chain — shadow copy + boot recovery + Defender impairment within 30m on the same host
ucs.description: Hunts the canonical LockBit (2.0 / 3.0 Black / Green / 5.0) staging behaviour documented in CISA AA23-075A / AA23-165A: minutes before file encryption the operator chains vssadmin/wmic shadow-copy deletion, bcdedit boot-recovery tampering, wbadmin catalog deletion, and Defender/service tampering on the same endpoint. Detecting 3+ of these distinct tools within a short window catches LockBit's locker pre-flight whether the affiliate uses the StealBit/LockBit Black builder or the LockBit Green variant cloned from Conti.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as tools from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","sc.exe","net.exe","net1.exe") AND (Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR Processes.process="*shadowstorage*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*delete catalog*" OR Processes.process="*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*" OR Processes.process="*Set-MpPreference*" OR Processes.process="*Add-MpPreference*ExclusionPath*" OR Processes.process="*stop*\"WinDefend\"*" OR Processes.process="*sc*stop*MBAMService*" OR Processes.process="*sc*stop*Sophos*" OR Processes.process="*sc*stop*BackupExec*" OR Processes.process="*sc*stop*MsMpSvc*") by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=30m | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime dc(tools) as unique_tools values(tools) as tools values(cmdlines) as cmdlines by dest user | where unique_tools >= 3 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let Window = 30m;
let DestructiveCmds = dynamic(["delete shadows","shadowcopy delete","resize shadowstorage","recoveryenabled no","recoveryenabled\tno","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","delete catalog -quiet","DisableRealtimeMonitoring","Set-MpPreference","Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath","MpCmdRun.exe -RemoveDefinitions"]);
let StoppedSvcs = dynamic(["WinDefend","MBAMService","Sophos","BackupExec","Veeam","SQLWriter","SQLTELEMETRY","MSSQLServer","MsMpSvc","SAVService","ekrn","avp","McAfee"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","sc.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","taskkill.exe","mpcmdrun.exe")
| extend CmdLower = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
| where CmdLower has_any (DestructiveCmds)
   or (FileName in~ ("sc.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","taskkill.exe") and (CmdLower has "stop" or CmdLower has "/im ") and CmdLower has_any (StoppedSvcs))
| extend Bucket = bin(Timestamp, Window)
| summarize ToolsUsed = dcount(FileName),
            ToolsSeen = make_set(FileName, 16),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 16)
          by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, Bucket
| where ToolsUsed >= 3   // 3 distinct destructive tools in 30m = LockBit pre-encryption staging
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Window = 30m;
let DestructiveCmds = dynamic(["delete shadows","shadowcopy delete","resize shadowstorage","recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","delete catalog -quiet","DisableRealtimeMonitoring","Set-MpPreference","Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath","MpCmdRun.exe -RemoveDefinitions"]);
let StoppedSvcs = dynamic(["WinDefend","MBAMService","Sophos","BackupExec","Veeam","SQLWriter","MSSQLServer","MsMpSvc","SAVService","ekrn","avp"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend Img = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])), CmdLower = tolower(CommandLine)
| where Img in ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","sc.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","taskkill.exe","mpcmdrun.exe")
| where CmdLower has_any (DestructiveCmds)
   or (Img in ("sc.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","taskkill.exe") and (CmdLower has "stop" or CmdLower has "/im ") and CmdLower has_any (StoppedSvcs))
| extend Bucket = bin(TimeGenerated, Window)
| summarize ToolsUsed = dcount(Img), ToolsSeen = make_set(Img, 16),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            SampleCmds = make_set(CommandLine, 16)
          by Computer, SubjectUserName, Bucket
| where ToolsUsed >= 3
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LockBit Pre-Encryption Recovery / Defense Tampering Burst
id: 7c0a6e6f-9b1f-4b1a-a8c5-lockbit-prep-01
status: experimental
description: One host running >=3 distinct destructive Windows tools (shadow copy, boot recovery, defender impair, service stop) within 30 minutes - hallmark of LockBit 2.0/3.0/Green/5.0 pre-locker staging.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-165a
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-075a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/23
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\vssadmin.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
      - '\bcdedit.exe'
      - '\wbadmin.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\sc.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
      - '\taskkill.exe'
      - '\mpcmdrun.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete shadows'
      - 'shadowcopy delete'
      - 'resize shadowstorage'
      - 'recoveryenabled no'
      - 'bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'
      - 'delete catalog'
      - 'DisableRealtimeMonitoring'
      - 'Set-MpPreference'
      - 'Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath'
      - '-RemoveDefinitions'
      - 'stop "WinDefend"'
      - 'stop MBAMService'
      - 'stop Sophos'
      - 'stop BackupExec'
      - 'stop Veeam'
      - 'stop MsMpSvc'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and not filter_machine
fields:
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - User
  - Computer
falsepositives:
  - Backup/recovery admin maintenance windows (rare to chain 3+ of these tools)
  - Endpoint hardening scripts run by SCCM
level: high
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1489
  - attack.t1562.001
  - threat.lockbit

ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wmic|bcdedit|wbadmin|powershell|pwsh|cmd|sc|net|net1|taskkill|mpcmdrun)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(delete\\s+shadows|shadowcopy\\s+delete|resize\\s+shadowstorage|recoveryenabled\\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\\s+ignoreallfailures|delete\\s+catalog|DisableRealtimeMonitoring|Set-MpPreference|Add-MpPreference\\s+-ExclusionPath|-RemoveDefinitions|stop\\s+\"?(WinDefend|MBAMService|Sophos|BackupExec|Veeam|MsMpSvc|SAVService|ekrn|avp|MSSQLServer))", field=CommandLine)

ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit affiliate fan-out execution from \\SYSVOL or \\NETLOGON — GPO-pushed locker hitting many domain members
ucs.description: Hunts LockBit's signature mass-deployment pattern: after compromising a DC the affiliate edits the Default Domain Policy (or a new GPO) to push a scheduled task / startup script that pulls the locker from \\<DC>\SYSVOL or \\<DC>\NETLOGON, achieving simultaneous ransomware execution across the estate. Detecting the SAME binary launched from a SYSVOL/NETLOGON UNC path across ≥5 hosts inside 30 minutes is a near-certain indicator of LockBit (or Conti-lineage Black Basta / Akira) GPO abuse.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_path) as paths values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents values(Processes.dest) as hosts dc(Processes.dest) as host_count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_path="\\\\*\\SYSVOL\\*" OR Processes.process_path="\\\\*\\NETLOGON\\*" OR Processes.parent_process_path="\\\\*\\SYSVOL\\*" OR Processes.parent_process_path="\\\\*\\NETLOGON\\*") AND Processes.process_name="*.exe" AND NOT Processes.process_name IN ("gpscript.exe","gpupdate.exe","setup.exe","msiexec.exe") by Processes.process_hash Processes.process_name _time span=30m | where host_count >= 5 | sort - host_count | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
ucs.kql:
let Window = 30m;
let MinHosts = 5;
let KnownGood = dynamic(["gpscript.exe","gpupdate.exe","setup.exe","msiexec.exe","wuauclt.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName endswith ".exe"
| where FileName !in~ (KnownGood)
| extend FromShare = (FolderPath startswith @"\\" and (FolderPath has @"\SYSVOL\" or FolderPath has @"\NETLOGON\"))
          or (InitiatingProcessFolderPath startswith @"\\" and (InitiatingProcessFolderPath has @"\SYSVOL\" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has @"\NETLOGON\"))
| where FromShare
| extend SharePath = iff(FolderPath startswith @"\\", FolderPath, InitiatingProcessFolderPath)
| summarize HostCount = dcount(DeviceId),
            Hosts    = make_set(DeviceName, 100),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine),
            SamplePath = any(SharePath)
          by SHA256, FileName, bin(Timestamp, Window)
| where HostCount >= MinHosts
| order by HostCount desc, FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Window = 30m;
let MinHosts = 5;
let KnownGood = dynamic(["gpscript.exe","gpupdate.exe","setup.exe","msiexec.exe","wuauclt.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend Img = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where Img endswith ".exe" and Img !in (KnownGood)
| where NewProcessName startswith "\\\\" or ParentProcessName startswith "\\\\"
| where NewProcessName has "\\SYSVOL\\" or NewProcessName has "\\NETLOGON\\"
      or ParentProcessName has "\\SYSVOL\\" or ParentProcessName has "\\NETLOGON\\"
| summarize HostCount = dcount(Computer),
            Hosts    = make_set(Computer, 100),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated),
            SampleCmd = any(CommandLine),
            SamplePath = any(NewProcessName)
          by FileHash, Img, bin(TimeGenerated, Window)
| where HostCount >= MinHosts
| order by HostCount desc, FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) (@Image:(*\\SYSVOL\\* OR *\\sysvol\\* OR *\\NETLOGON\\* OR *\\netlogon\\*) OR @ParentImage:(*\\SYSVOL\\* OR *\\sysvol\\* OR *\\NETLOGON\\* OR *\\netlogon\\*)) @Image:*.exe -@Image:(*\\gpscript.exe OR *\\GPScript.exe OR *\\gpupdate.exe OR *\\GPUpdate.exe OR *\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MsiExec.exe OR *\\wuauclt.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\.exe$/i
| (regex("(?i)\\\\sysvol\\\\", field=ImageFileName) OR regex("(?i)\\\\netlogon\\\\", field=ImageFileName) OR regex("(?i)\\\\sysvol\\\\", field=ParentImageFileName) OR regex("(?i)\\\\netlogon\\\\", field=ParentImageFileName))
| NOT ImageFileName=/\\(gpscript|gpupdate|msiexec|wuauclt|setup)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([SHA256HashData, ImageFileName], function=[count(field=aid, distinct=true, as=HostCount), collect([ComputerName], limit=100, as=Hosts), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen), selectFromMin(field="@timestamp", include=[CommandLine, ImageFileName])])
| HostCount >= 5
| sort(field=HostCount, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: GPO-based mass deployment is LockBit's most-distinctive distribution technique — first publicly documented when LockBit 2.0 introduced the StealBit/Locker module that auto-creates a new GPO from a compromised DC and writes the locker to SYSVOL (see CISA AA22-040A and Sophos LockBit 2.0 GPO writeup). Legitimate software almost never runs out of \\<DC>\SYSVOL or \\<DC>\NETLOGON on member endpoints —
